Priya Rao: Heads-up—final interview loop for candidate Sam Iqbal on Thu Apr 10. Candidate is remote (GMT+1). Plan is hybrid: candidate remote, panel partly in SF office. Need parking pass, loaner laptop, boxed lunch (vegan option), and a remote fallback. Can @Ben Carter and @Alex Kim confirm panel availability?

Ben Carter: I'm available for the loop. I'll take intro + system design. @Priya can we get a senior infra person too? :thumbsup:

Alex Kim: I can cover scale/infra. Quick note on timezones — original slot 13:00–16:30 BST maps to very early PST. Do we have candidate morning availability instead?

Priya Rao: Good point. Candidate said mornings are better. Suggest shifting to ~10:30–14:00 BST so candidate isn't late afternoon. @Evelyn Park can you check final availability and update invite windows?

Evelyn Park: Reached out to Sam — they prefer 10:00–14:00 BST. Updated the scheduling sheet (row 42). I'll tentatively book SF-Maple-2 for the in-person panel and request parking. Ordering boxed lunches: 2 vegan, 1 gluten-free, rest omnivore.

People Ops Bot: Calendar invites created for tentative slot 2026-04-10 10:30 BST -> 14:00 BST. Invites include Zoom fallback and dial-in. RSVP statuses: Ben (accepted), Alex (accepted), others pending.

Alex Kim: I'll need a loaner MacBook with 16GB and charger. @Evelyn can you file device request?

Evelyn Park: Filed loaner request with device-ops (ticket #DO-4532). Parking pass reservation done — will be at front desk under "Sam Iqbal". Lunch order finalized.

Priya Rao: Adding remote fallback details to invite. Zoom + phone backup. Candidate will receive an email with arrival instructions, office address, and door code. Please prep any panel materials and upload to drive. Also reminder: fill out the standard feedback form within 24h.

Ben Carter: I'll upload a 1-pager with interview prompts + system prompt to Drive (link: https://drive.redwood/recruiting/sam_iqbal). Will add a short PT task for backend perf.

Priya Rao: Door code & quick office snippet for the candidate (sent via secure email):
```
Office: Redwood HQ, 123 Market St, 3rd floor (Maple)
Visitor check-in: Front desk, say "Sam Iqbal"
Door code: 4829
Nearest BART: Embarcadero
Parking: Reserved under guest list (SF-Maple-2)
```

People Ops Bot: Candidate confirmation email queued for 2026-04-09 10:00 BST. Final logistics email will include: travel reimbursement instructions, parking details, remote link, dietary notes, and loaner pickup instructions.

Evelyn Park: All set from ops side — loaner requested, room reserved, lunch ordered, parking pass done. I'll send the final candidate email and copy the panel at 10:00 BST tomorrow. Closing logistics for this thread unless anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
